[[File:Jerry Darcy 2020.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jerry Darcy in 2020. Still: SWCCG Holotheatre.]]
'''Jerry Darcy''' was the lead designer of Decipher's ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game (SWCCG) from ''A New Hope'' (1996) through ''Endor'' (1999). He created [[Objective]]s.<ref name="holo-lead">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA&t=1631s Star Wars CCG – 11/11/20 Holotheatre – Interview: Jerry Darcy], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee) (11 November 2020), 27:11–29:12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165228/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/11 November 2020 transcript]].</ref><ref name="holo-obj">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA&t=1783s Star Wars CCG – 11/11/20 Holotheatre – Interview: Jerry Darcy], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee) (11 November 2020), 29:43–33:21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165228/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/11 November 2020 transcript]].</ref>

== SWCCG work ==

Darcy came to Decipher through Technical Game Services, the company of [[Tom Braunlich]] and [[Rollie Tesh]]. He moved from Cincinnati and started on 14 April 1995, during [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]], to work out card details.<ref name="rfd12-start" /><ref name="bp-hours">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc&t=789s The Booster Pack #28 — The making of the Star Wars CCG with Tom Braunlich], The Booster Pack Network (24 August 2022), 13:09–14:12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221006131758/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[The Booster Pack/Episode 28 transcript]].</ref> In the nightly card sessions, Braunlich proposed functions and Darcy set the numbers.<ref name="bp-sessions">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc&t=1283s The Booster Pack #28 — The making of the Star Wars CCG with Tom Braunlich], The Booster Pack Network (24 August 2022), 21:23–23:57. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221006131758/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[The Booster Pack/Episode 28 transcript]].</ref> Braunlich credits Darcy with most of the names Decipher invented for background characters, and [[Jason Winter]] recalls that he wrote much of the cards' lore.<ref name="bp-lore">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc&t=3403s The Booster Pack #28 — The making of the Star Wars CCG with Tom Braunlich], The Booster Pack Network (24 August 2022), 56:43–57:43. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221006131758/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[The Booster Pack/Episode 28 transcript]].</ref><ref name="winter-lore">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=2356s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (Jason Winter interview)], Imperial Remnant (23 November 2025), 39:16–40:16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165322/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref> As lead designer he reviewed card ideas from [[Chuck Kallenbach]], [[Tom Lischke]] and Mike Reynolds. He set the themes and mechanics of [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] before moving to [[Young Jedi]].<ref name="rfd12-lead">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DsqnSbxT25c&t=88s Broadcast 12 – Radio Free Decipher (2 April 1999): Bill Martinson, Jerry Darcy on PD (Part 1)], Decipher; posted by Player's Council (aired 2 April 1999), 1:28–2:28. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-DsqnSbxT25c Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 12 transcript]].</ref> Darcy discussed the early expansions in a series of KendallCast interviews.<ref name="kendall">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/05/jerry-darcy-on-premiere-new-hope-and.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Premiere, A New Hope, and Hoth] (3 May 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195122/https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/05/jerry-darcy-on-premiere-new-hope-and.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="kendall2">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/11/jerry-darcy-on-dagobah.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Dagobah] (2 November 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009004205/https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/11/jerry-darcy-on-dagobah.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="kendall3">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/10/corran-on-horn-13-jerry-darcy-on.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Special Edition] (10 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009004206/https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/10/corran-on-horn-13-jerry-darcy-on.html Internet Archive].</ref>

=== Objectives ===

Darcy created Objectives, introduced in [[Special Edition]], because numbers decks had come to dominate. He wanted movie storylines, such as freezing Han in carbonite or destroying a planet with the Death Star, to become deck strategies. His first version stretched the [[Epic Event]] layout across the whole card, which left no room for art. The fix came at a mall food court, when he saw a pepperoni stuck under a pizza slice: cards have two sides.<ref name="holo-obj" />

=== Krayt Dragon ===

While Decipher worked on Premiere, West End Games identified the bones seen in ''A New Hope'' as a krayt dragon's, which inspired [[Krayt Dragon Howl]]. Darcy then pushed for a dragon card of its own, and artist [[Joe Boulden]] built the image for [[Krayt Dragon]] in [[Special Edition]].<ref name="holo-krayt">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0&t=1208s Star Wars CCG – 11/18/20 Holotheatre – Jerry Darcy interview], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee) (18 November 2020), 20:08–23:11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165210/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0 Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/18 November 2020 transcript]].</ref> Darcy has not worked on ''Star Wars'' since 2000.<ref name="holo-mando">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0&t=1391s Star Wars CCG – 11/18/20 Holotheatre – Jerry Darcy interview], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee) (18 November 2020), 23:11–24:44. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165210/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NaVhk9CrrV0 Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/18 November 2020 transcript]].</ref>

Darcy is thanked in the credits of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] rulebook (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive].</ref> The GeoCities anagram table maps [[Rayc Ryjerd]] and [[Rycar Ryjerd]] to Jerry Darcy, [[Djas Puhr]] to his cat Jasper, and [[Laudica]] to [[Claudia Darcy]].<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]</ref>
